data.verdict_reason: One of two criteria is met (c1 verified by both code inspection and independent test pass). The second criterion (c2: password length < 8 chars) is entirely unmet—the code lacks any password validation logic, despite the assistant's explicit claim that both rules were implemented. The independent test passing confirms the implemented functionality works but does not guarantee full requirements coverage.
recommendations: Add password parameter to validate function and implement length check: password.length >= 8
Update signup.js to pass password to validate() and check the returned error
Run test suite with explicit test cases for both email and password validation before marking complete
